name: AI Salon Pro
install: cd "Urban Nail Bar (macOS High Sierra)/server" && npm install --omit=dev --omit=optional --no-fund --no-audit

terminals.name: Salon server
terminals.command: export SALON_PRO_ROOT="$(pwd)" && export SALON_DATA_FILE="$SALON_PRO_ROOT/_shared-salon-data/data-store.json" && cd "Urban Nail Bar (macOS High Sierra)/server" && node salon-server.js
terminals.description: Keeps the staff app on port 3001 and public booking on port 3002. Leave this running so Cursor can forward the ports.
